name: web-autonomous-taxi-site-lime-cards-and-vehicle-slider
title: Autonomous taxi site: black stats block and white vehicle slider with lime highlight
whatItIs: A rounded framed page on black with two sections: a black one with a two-tone statement and three stat cards (lime, white, dark), and a white one with the headline 'Autonomous. Effortless.' where the second word has a lime marker highlight above a centred white van with blurred neighbouring vehicles and arrow buttons. A single vehicle render sits below the frame.
whatItMeans: Clean and confident; the lime highlight and blurred neighbours give a modern, focused product carousel.
techniques: Highlight a headline word with a tilted lime marker block.
Use three stat cards in different fills (lime, white, dark) as a set.
Blur the previous and next slides in a carousel to show depth.
Flip from a black section to a white one within one rounded frame.
bestFor: Mobility, hardware and product-led landing pages
Sites with vehicle or product carousels
Bold black, white and neon brands

vocabulary.definition: A coloured block behind a word, like highlighter pen.
Adjacent carousel items shown out of focus.
A card with a key fact.
Switching between dark and light sections.
